record.title: Observe one confirmed power cycle and fresh stock readiness
record.intent: Determine whether a fresh ordinary boot restores the native verification path while preserving the specimen corpus.
requirements: Commit and push reviewed preparation before arming capture and asking the operator to power-cycle once. Preserve explicit capture readiness, screen-dark shutdown confirmation, power-on-ready cue and start confirmation with timestamps. Keep capture and lease observation healthy across both manual steps. Accept a new matching ACK after the power-on-ready cue even if it precedes the start-confirmation message; no automatic second reset, native change or reboot command.

Capture actual new lease negotiation and verify one fresh postboot ADB session, stock APK/native mappings and hashes, changed boot identity, new process epoch and unchanged protected material. If root setup is needed, use only the preparation contract's single bounded branch. Stop on transport ambiguity, unexpected traffic, UI prompt, mapping or corpus mismatch.

Bind a current normal UI witness to the fresh stock epoch, observe stock 17/17 through the established bounded reader and verify stability after greater than 1800 seconds serviced warm-up. Preserve immutable raw evidence, before/after host manifests, owned helper retirement before alias removal, graceful recorder/drop statistics and independently reviewed restoration. No RF record belongs to this recovery.
acceptance: One successful or explicitly stopped recovery observation is sealed without a retry.

review.rationale: Reviewed the preparation revision in .agents/plans/rf-stock-recovery-root-readiness-revision.yaml: the existing observer may use one conditional adb root only after a UID witness, followed by exactly one bounded post-root readiness sequence. This does not authorize repeated failed sessions, remount, persistent properties or an additional reset. Observation still requires separately confirmed shutdown/start, a new post-cue lease, fresh stock epoch, unchanged protected content, normal UI and serviced warm-up. No observation has executed; the contract remains applicable.
